correctness.rationale: Explicit endemic coordinates satisfy all four equations and positivity follows from R0>1. Orthogonal eigenmode reduction is exact for proportional symmetric infection matrices. All three cubic coefficients are strictly positive; the Hurwitz determinant is positive at t=0 by d>=gamma and u>alpha, and strictly increasing for t>=0. Full-space population modes decay at rate mu. Universal symbolic characteristic polynomial identity was independently checked.
